item.title: Italian Coffee Drinks: The Complete Guide to Italy's Espresso Bar Menu
item.description: Every Italian coffee drink explained: espresso, doppio, ristretto, lungo, macchiato, cappuccino, caffè latte, latte macchiato, americano, mocha, marocchino, bicerin, espresso con panna, shakerato, and affogato. Ratios, glassware, when Italians drink each one, and how to order like a local.
